entities.name: Terrik
entities.description: A disgraced Selesnyan elven wurmcaller who accidentally collapsed the Basilica of the Opportune with his wurm and tries to redeem himself by helping the orphan Bazda and his friends.

entities.name: Ambrellin
entities.description: A dryad artifact broker, Terrik's childhood friend, who shelters him and identifies Bazda's Izzet artifact.

entities.name: Savaryn
entities.description: A strong loxodon of the Selesnya army, Terrik's friend, who is promoted to director of a new training facility.

entities.name: Kellim
entities.description: A human architect of tranquil sanctuaries, Terrik's friend, hired to design the new facility.

entities.name: Bazda
entities.description: A sharp twelve-year-old orphan whose parents died in the basilica collapse and who owns the missing piece of an ancient Izzet coin-minting machine.

entities.name: Kadin and Zavora
entities.description: Bazda's parents, workers killed in the basilica collapse who now toil as indebted spirits for the pontiff; the mother is Zavora.

entities.name: The Orzhov Pontiff
entities.description: A desperate Orzhov pontiff who binds spirits and trespassers with contract magic, using a staff and wurms to dig for the missing piece of a coin-minting machine; he fuses a thrull to his leg.

entities.name: The Pontiff's Thrull
entities.description: The pontiff's attendant thrull, who jumps into the hole after him and is fused to his leg.

entities.name: Terrik's Wurm
entities.description: A young wurm Terrik raised from a hatchling and hid as his bed, who flees at the sound of the pontiff's captive wurms and later carries the group out.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of harmony, to which Terrik and his friends belong.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of wealth, contracts and spirits, whose territory holds the ruined basilica.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of chemisters and inventors whose ancient machinery produced the coin mill.

entities.name: Basilica of the Opportune
entities.description: An ancient Orzhov church that Terrik's wurm collapsed, killing nearly two dozen workers; its catacombs hold the Izzet machine.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The sacred Selesnyan tree-city on whose roots Terrik swears.

entities.name: The Coin Mill
entities.description: An ancient Izzet stone machine in the catacombs that mints gold coins from copper, missing a crescent piece that Bazda holds.

entities.name: Bazda's Artifact
entities.description: A crescent-shaped carved stone with golden symbols, found by Bazda's father at the basilica, that completes the coin mill.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Ambrellin tells Terrik to forgive himself, and he hides a wurm under his bed while telling her the neighbors' wurm sightings are over-meditation.
events.quote: do you really think I'd be able to fit a half-grown wurm under my bed?

events.summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
events.quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

events.summary: Children at the orphanage recognize Terrik as the wurmcaller who destroyed the basilica, and Bazda defends him with a hairpin.
events.quote: Bazda pulls a six-inch hairpin from her right bun and jabs it at the punk

events.summary: Bazda shows Terrik an ancient crescent artifact her father found at the basilica, and Terrik promises to have Ambrellin look at it.
events.quote: My father gave me this a couple days before he died.

events.summary: Bazda steals Terrik's shears and follows him home to the Selesnyan cooperative.
events.quote: It's only fair I hold something valuable of yours.

events.summary: Ambrellin identifies Bazda's artifact as ancient Izzet technology and calls it priceless.
events.quote: I've seen them before on ancient Izzet machinery

events.summary: Savaryn announces his promotion and that he and Kellim will move away, upsetting Terrik.
events.quote: We're not commuting,

events.summary: Terrik proposes one last adventure and reveals his young wurm is his bed; the friends reluctantly agree to explore beneath the basilica.
events.quote: Not quite. The wurm is the bed.

events.summary: Terrik's wurm tunnels them to the catacombs beneath the basilica, where a trap statue pulls Ambrellin into a passage; the wurm bolts and the floor collapses.
events.quote: Then the entire floor gives out, and there's nowhere for us to go but down.

events.summary: Stuck, Ambrellin finally admits she is angry and tells Terrik his friends are leaving because of his behavior; Terrik walks away alone.
events.quote: Okay I'm angry with you, are you happy?

events.summary: Terrik finds an Orzhov pontiff using abused wurms and spirits to dig for a missing piece of an Izzet coin machine.
events.quote: Faster! It's got to be buried around here somewhere,

events.summary: A rat startles Savaryn, waking the gargoyles, and the pontiff captures Terrik and Savaryn, forcing them to sign indenture contracts.
events.quote: Sign it or become wurm food.

events.summary: Terrik learns the machine mints gold from copper and meets Bazda's mother among the spirits, bound by contract.
events.quote: You're Bazda's mother?

events.summary: Terrik and Savaryn tear up the pontiff's contract book, but the pontiff restores it and questions Terrik under a verity spell.
events.quote: Then the pontiff reaches down into the mist and pulls back a perfectly bound book, pages all intact.

events.summary: Bazda secretly passes her artifact to Terrik as the pontiff searches the prisoners.
events.quote: Her quick thieving hands had planted it on me without me even noticing.

events.summary: A captive wurm collapses from the pontiff's pain magic, and Terrik, recognizing it as one of his own, plans revenge with Bazda's mother's help.
events.quote: He's one of mine, I know it.

events.summary: Disguised as a statue and with Bazda's mother's help, Terrik hurls the pontiff into the pit and tears up the contracts; the thrull jumps in after him.
events.quote: I pitch him into the hole.

events.summary: Ambrellin repairs the coin mill with Bazda's artifact and Savaryn pushes it, producing gold to pay off everyone's debts.
events.quote: The first gold coin tumbles out the chute, and I catch it in my hands.

events.summary: The pontiff returns with the thrull fused to his leg, but Terrik pays off the debts and the contracts release, freeing the spirits.
events.quote: I'm paying off all of our debts. We are no longer bound to your contracts.

events.summary: The group escapes on the wurm through molten rock with weaving healing spells, and Bazda is reunited with her parents.
events.quote: Mama? Papa?

events.summary: Terrik returns Bazda's artifact via Ambrellin and the friends find Terrik's wurm asleep in the neighbors' bed.
events.quote: Looks like she found her way back home, give or take a floor.

relations.note: Childhood friends, though she is angry with him.
relations.quote: a tell she's had since we were kids.
Savaryn, he's a loxodon, brawny as they come and isn't afraid of anything.
Kellim is an architect who designs the most tranquil sanctuaries.

relations.note: His wurm collapsed it, killing the workers, though the pontiff later admits his own digging was at fault.
relations.quote: I'd ridden my wurm underneath it, compromising its structural support
Can you give me my parents back?
Oh, you're going to be in debt to my family for generations.
An Orzhov pontiff, if I remember their rankings right.

relations.note: Trained by the Selesnyans for twenty-eight years.
relations.quote: Twenty-eight years of Selesnyan training has taught me to maintain harmony

relations.note: He raised her from a hatchling.
relations.quote: I raised her from a hatchling.
